name: plugins-claude
description: Pluginuri Claude Code pentru pipeline-uri CI (GitHub Actions): revizie de PR, verificare, reparare automata, release

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Revizie de pull request: corectitudine, securitate, baza de date; constatarile grave verificate adversarial; raport JSON + Markdown

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verificare independenta: build + teste, PASS/FAIL cu dovezi si cauze infra/toolkit/cod

plugins.name: auto-fix
plugins.description: Reparare automata: fix + test care reproduce problema, verificare independenta in bucla, corpul PR-ului

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Release: imagine cu tag sha7, image.tag in repo-ul GitOps, verificare ArgoCD; push/commit doar la cerere
